items.titleEn: Fiserv Unifies Financial and Merchant Divisions to Unlock Growth Opportunities
items.summaryEn: Fiserv aims to tap several growth opportunities by bringing together the capabilities of its Financial Solutions (FS) and Merchant Solutions (MS) segments, which have operated separately, and operating as one company, Fiserv CEO Takis Georgakopoulos said Thursday (Sept. 10). Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_1" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); Speaking at the Goldman Sachs 2026 Communacopia + Technology conference, Georgakopoulos said that by changing its previous structure and operating as one company, Fiserv can better serve parts of the business that were underused because they touch both FS and MS or they sat on one side of the business while primarily benefiting the other.

items.titleEn: CME's 24/7 silver futures debut with $15 million traded in first weekend
items.summaryEn: (Kitco News) - In a world of heightened economic uncertainty, investors continue to embrace the ability to own and trade safe-haven assets 24 hours a day, seven days a week, as CME Group announces the successful launch of its 24/7 silver contract. The world's largest derivatives exchange said Monday that 2,387 100-Ounce Silver futures contracts traded during its inaugural weekend of 24/7 trading, representing more than $15 million in notional value. Along with solid silver demand, CME said it continues to see strong demand for its 24/7 one-ounce gold contract, which was launched July 24.
